kpi_name: Percentage of planned tax audits completed annually by Domestic Revenue Department

kpi_name: Percentage of planned tax audits completed annually by Large Taxpayers
definition: 1.1.1 Enhanced Tax Audit and Enforcement Programs
calculation_method: Percentage of completed audit cases as per Annual Business Plan
means_of_verification: Consolidated department audit report

kpi_name: Number of compliance risk assessments conducted using Advanced Data Analytics by June 2031
definition: 1.1.2 Advanced Data Analytics for Compliance Risk Assessment
calculation_method: Count of distinct compliance risk assessments conducted using data analytics during the reporting period
means_of_verification: Compliance Risk Assessment Reports

kpi_name: Percentage of planned Post Clearance Audits completed annually.
definition: 1.1.3 Enhanced Post Clearance Audit and Physical Verification of Cargo
calculation_method: Percentage of completed audit cases as per Annual Plan
means_of_verification: TANCIS system report

kpi_name: Percentage of selected cargo (red) for physical verification conducted

calculation_method: Total number of cargos verified against selected

kpi_name: Percentage of revenue collected from previous tax arrears (older than twelve month)

calculation_method: Total revenue collected from previous tax arrears divide by previous arrears x 100
means_of_verification: TANCIS system report

kpi_name: Ratio of total tax arrears (recovered) over total revenue collected for the year

means_of_verification: TANCIS system report

kpi_name: Percentage of normal flow taxes collected against total revenue collected by 2030/31

kpi_name: Percentage of revenue collected from current tax arrears (within twelve month) by 2030/31

kpi_name: Percentage of revenue collected from previous collectable tax arrears (older than twelve month) by 2030/31
definition: 1.1.6 Enhanced Management of Current and Previous Arrears (Domestic Revenues)
calculation_method: Percentage amount of revenue collected from previous collectable arrears against total collectable previous arrears
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: Ratio of total tax arrears over total revenue collected for the year

kpi_name: Percentage of Memorandums of Understanding vetted within the prescribed timeframe.

kpi_name: Percentage of legal opinions issued annually

calculation_method: Number of Legal Opinions Provided over Number of Legal Opinion requests issued
means_of_verification: Correspondence Register

kpi_name: Percentage of cases successfully defended
definition: 1.1.9 Improved effectiveness in tax dispute resolution & litigation management
calculation_method: Number of Cases won and withdrawn over Total Number of Cases with exception of partly decided cases and settled cases
means_of_verification: Case Management System Report

kpi_name: Value of government revenue protected through litigation
definition: 1.1.9 Improved effectiveness in tax dispute resolution & litigation management
calculation_method: Total value of won cases and withdrawn cases
means_of_verification: Case Management System Report

kpi_name: Number of tax laws/regulations reviewed or drafted
definition: 1.1.10 Strengthened legislative and regulatory framework for tax administration
calculation_method: Total Number of Laws or regulation reviewed or Drafted
means_of_verification: Finance Act

kpi_name: Number of legal inputs submitted to Government policy processes
definition: 1.1.10 Strengthened legislative and regulatory framework for tax administration
calculation_method: Number of Contracts reviewed over Number of Contracts submitted for review
means_of_verification: Correspondence Register

kpi_name: Percentage of TRA contracts legally reviewed before signing
definition: 1.1.11 Improved contract management and legal documentation
calculation_method: Number of Contracts reviewed over Number of Contracts submitted for review
means_of_verification: Correspondence Register

kpi_name: Number of surveillance audits conducted to VAT exemption beneficiaries

means_of_verification: Risk Profiling Report, Surveillance Audit Report

kpi_name: Number of Board Meetings Conducted
definition: 1.1.13 Enhanced corporate governance and strategic oversight through timely Board deliberations, approvals, & monitoring of organizational performance

means_of_verification: Board Minutes, Board Matters Arising

kpi_name: Percentage of deliberations made by the Board and implemented
definition: 1.1.13 Enhanced corporate governance and strategic oversight through timely Board deliberations, approvals, & monitoring of organizational performance
calculation_method: Number of deliberations implemented over Number of deliberations Issued
means_of_verification: Board Minutes, Board Matters Arising

kpi_name: Average time (days) taken from Arrival of Goods to Removal (exit)
definition: 1.1.14 Reduced clearance time of goods
calculation_method: (Sum of time of exit minus sum of time of arrival) over total consignments
means_of_verification: TANCIS clearance Module and Time release report

kpi_name: Average time (days) taken from Lodgement to Issuance of Assessment
definition: 1.1.14 Reduced clearance time of goods
calculation_method: (Sum of time of document assessment minus sum of time of lodgement) over total documents
means_of_verification: TANCIS report for documents with clearance plan
data_source: TANCIS report for documents with clearance plan

kpi_name: Percentage of goods whose assessment is made within 24 hours
definition: 1.1.14 Reduced clearance time of goods
calculation_method: Total number of assessed documents within 24 hours divide by the number of documents lodged in a certain day times a 100
means_of_verification: TANCIS clearance module and Time release report

kpi_name: Reduction in Overall Tax Gap to GDP ratio
definition: 1.2 Reduced Tax Gap
calculation_method: Tax Gap over GDP
means_of_verification: Tax gap studies

kpi_name: Percentage Reduction in Revenue Leakage from Discretionary Adjustments for Tax Investigation
definition: 1.2 Reduced Tax Gap
calculation_method: Change in revenue loss resulting from discretionary measures divide by total revenue times 100
means_of_verification: Discretionary Measures reports, Revenue collection Reports

kpi_name: Annual Reduction in Estimated Compliance Gap
definition: 1.2 Reduced Tax Gap
calculation_method: {Current year Compliance Gap minus previous year compliance Gap} divide by the previous year compliance Gap) times 100
means_of_verification: Compliance reports

kpi_name: Enforcement action success rate
definition: 1.2.1 Compliance Gap Reduced
calculation_method: (Number of enforcement actions resulting in confirmed tax liability, revenue recovery, or legally sustained outcomes ÷ Total number of enforcement actions completed during the reporting period) × 100
means_of_verification: Revenue recovery/payment records linked to enforcement actions/Appeals and objection decisions (upheld vs overturned cases)/ Case closure reports and quarterly enforcement reports
data_source: Revenue recovery/payment records linked to enforcement actions

kpi_name: Number of New Data Sharing Agreements Established
definition: 1.2.2 Strengthened Compliance Audit and Enforcement Framework
calculation_method: The count of formal Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) or data sharing agreements signed with other government agencies or key private sector entities for accessing data relevant to tax administration and compliance
means_of_verification: TRA Intra-portal report

kpi_name: Increase in Undeclared Income/Assets Identified via Data Matching
definition: 1.2.3 Enhanced Third-Party Data Integration for Compliance
calculation_method: (Baseline value Actual value of undeclared income/assets identified ÷ Baseline Value) × 100
means_of_verification: Data matching reports from IDRAS / TANCIS / third-party data integrations and Investigation reports with additional assessments form undeclared income/assets

kpi_name: Frequency of Joint Compliance Initiatives with Partner Agencies
definition: 1.2.3 Enhanced Third-Party Data Integration for Compliance
calculation_method: Total Number of Joint Compliance Initiatives Conducted in the Period
means_of_verification: Approved joint operation plans with partner agencies, /Joint operation reports (field reports, compliance sweep reports)/ Case registers showing multi-agency involvement
data_source: Approved joint operation plans with partner agencies

kpi_name: Number of Evidence-Based Policy/Legislative Recommendations Submitted
definition: 1.2.4 Proactive Tax Policy and Legislative Review for Gap Closure
calculation_method: The count of formal, documented recommendations for tax policy or legislative changes submitted to the Minister for consideration, directly informed by tax gap analysis and research.
means_of_verification: Tax gap analysis reports, Legislative changes submitted to the Minister

kpi_name: Percentage of Submitted Recommendations Adopted/Implemented
definition: 1.2.4 Proactive Tax Policy and Legislative Review for Gap Closure
calculation_method: The proportion of proposed tax policy or legislative recommendations submitted by TRA that are formally adopted or implemented by the relevant legislative or executive authorities within a given period.
means_of_verification: Policies adopted

kpi_name: Estimated Revenue Impact from Adopted Reforms (0.8 to 1 % of GDP)
definition: 1.2.4 Proactive Tax Policy and Legislative Review for Gap Closure
calculation_method: The projected annual increase in tax revenue attributable to the implementation of new or amended tax policies/legislation that originated from TRA's recommendations for tax gap closure.
means_of_verification: Revenue collection report Approved tax reforms Finance Act

kpi_name: Rate of Increase in registered taxpayers
definition: 1.2.4 Proactive Tax Policy and Legislative Review for Gap Closure
calculation_method: Percentage of registered taxpayer in current year minus previous year divide by previous year registered taxpayers times 100
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: On time Filing Rate by Domestic Revenue
definition: 1.3 Improved Registration, Filing and Payment Rate
calculation_method: Percentage of taxpayers filed returns on or before due date against eligible taxpayers to file return
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: On time Filing Rate by Large Tax Payers
definition: 1.3 Improved Registration, Filing and Payment Rate
calculation_method: Percentage of taxpayers filed returns on or before due date against eligible taxpayers to file return
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: On time Payment rate
definition: 1.3 Improved Registration, Filing and Payment Rate
calculation_method: Percentage of taxpayers paid taxes on or before due date against taxpayers paid taxes
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: Average time to complete a new taxpayer registration
definition: 1.3 Improved Registration, Filing and Payment Rate
calculation_method: Number of day (S) taken to issue TIN from date of receipt application
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: Number of days to respond written taxpayer inquiries
definition: 1.3.1 Simplified Online Taxpayer Registration System Implemented
calculation_method: Number of days attended inquiries from the date of receipts
means_of_verification: IDRAS report

kpi_name: Percentage of reduced number of objection cases received against total number of assessments issued by 2030/31 for Domestic Revenue
definition: 1.3.2 Enhanced Taxpayer Service and Support Mechanisms
calculation_method: Number of objections recorded divided by total number of assessment times 100
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: Percentage number of objection cases received against total number of assessments issued by 2030/31 for Large Tax Payers
definition: 1.3.3 Reduction of tax objections
calculation_method: Number of objections recorded divided by total number of assessment times 100
means_of_verification: IDRAS Report

kpi_name: Number of TRA stakeholders provided with demand-driven trainings
definition: 1.3.3 Reduction of tax objections
calculation_method: Total number of TRA stakeholders trained on demand-driven trainings during the reporting period
means_of_verification: Training Reports

kpi_name: Percentage of students enrolment for ITA's long-term programs
definition: 1.3.4 Expanded Scope and Quality of ITA Training Programmes to the General Public.
calculation_method: Current period enrolment minus previous period enrolment divided by previous period enrolment times 100
means_of_verification: Student Management System Reports

kpi_name: Increase in number of candidates enrolled in tax and customs certification programs
definition: 1.3.4 Expanded Scope and Quality of ITA Training Programmes to the General Public.
calculation_method: Physical count of enrolled candidates in Certification Programs
means_of_verification: Candidates register for each certificate program
data_source: Candidates register for each certificate program

kpi_name: Number of tracer studies conducted
definition: 1.3.4 Expanded Scope and Quality of ITA Training Programmes to the General Public.
calculation_method: Total number of tracer studies completed and documented during the reporting period
means_of_verification: Tracer studies Reports

kpi_name: Number of curricula reviewed/developed and approved
definition: 1.3.5 The quality of delivery and assessment improved
calculation_method: Total number of curricula that have been successfully reviewed/newly developed and formally approved during the reporting period.
means_of_verification: Curriculum development reports 2. Approval letters from relevant authorities (TCU/NACTVET) 3. Minutes of TRA Management/Board Meetings

kpi_name: Number of staffs trained on training delivery and assessment
definition: 1.3.5 The quality of delivery and assessment improved
calculation_method: Total number of staff who completed training on training delivery and assessment during the reporting period
means_of_verification: Training attendance registers 2. Training reports 3. Certificates of completion issued to staff

kpi_name: Number of teaching case studies developed
definition: 1.3.5 The quality of delivery and assessment improved
calculation_method: Total number of teaching case studies completed and approved for use in training or academic programs during the reporting period.
means_of_verification: Case study approval reports

kpi_name: Percentage of Newly Registered Taxpayers from Informal Sector
definition: 1.4 Expand Tax Base from the Informal Sector
calculation_method: Newly Registered Taxpayers from Informal Sector divide by total number of new taxpayers registered x 100
means_of_verification: IDRAS report

kpi_name: Percentage of taxpayers from informal sector graduated from minimum taxable income who are assessed and paid taxes
definition: 1.4 Expand Tax Base from the Informal Sector
calculation_method: Taxpayers from informal sector graduated from minimum taxable income who are assessed and paid taxes over total number of taxpayers from informal sector x 100
means_of_verification: IDRAS report

kpi_name: Number of Informal Sector Awareness Campaigns Conducted Annually
definition: 1.4 Expand Tax Base from the Informal Sector
calculation_method: Total count of distinct awareness campaigns (e.g., radio, print, community events) specifically targeting the informal sector
means_of_verification: Script, Attendance, Invitation

kpi_name: Participation Rate in Informal Sector Taxpayer Workshops
definition: 1.4.1 Targeted Capacity Building and Awareness for Informal Sector Taxpayers
calculation_method: The percentage of invited or eligible informal sector entities that attend capacity-building workshops.
means_of_verification: List of invited participants

kpi_name: Percentage of TECD Taxpayer Communications Customized by Segment
definition: 1.4.1 Targeted Capacity Building and Awareness for Informal Sector Taxpayers
calculation_method: Number of taxpayers educated during the year over number of taxpayers targeted from the given segments times 100%
means_of_verification: Customised reminders, education materials

kpi_name: End-to-End Process Automation Rate
definition: 2.1 Improved End-to-End Automation
calculation_method: Number of processes fully automated divide by Total number of TRA processes mapped times 100.
means_of_verification: TRA Process Library / Inventory / BPR Reports.

kpi_name: Percentage of Processes Mapped for Automation
definition: 2.1 Improved End-to-End Automation
calculation_method: Number of process mapped for automation divide by Total number of processes automated x 100
means_of_verification: Enterprise automation platform dashboards/ reports, Digital Transformation progress reports.

kpi_name: Percentage of Core Processes Automated
definition: 2.1.1 Enterprise Automation Platform Implemented and Integrated
calculation_method: (Number of processes fully automated and operational on the enterprise automation platform ÷ Total number of core revenue and customs processes identified for automation in the approved automation blueprint) × 100.
means_of_verification: Enterprise automation platform dashboards/ reports, Digital Transformation progress reports.

kpi_name: Percentage of support Processes Automated
definition: 2.1.1 Enterprise Automation Platform Implemented and Integrated
calculation_method: (Number of processes fully automated and operational on the enterprise automation platform ÷ total number of support process identified for automation in the approved automation blueprint) × 100.
means_of_verification: Enterprise automation platform dashboards/ reports, Digital Transformation progress reports.

kpi_name: Number of Core Systems Integrated with Automation platform
definition: 2.1.1 Enterprise Automation Platform Implemented and Integrated
calculation_method: Count of core systems from the approved integration roadmap that have been successfully integrated with the enterprise automation platform, tested, and are operational in the production environment.
means_of_verification: Enterprise automation platform integration reports/dashboards, approved integration architecture or roadmap, API/middleware configuration records, Digital Transformation progress reports.

kpi_name: Number of New Automated Self-Service Features Available
definition: 2.1.2 Digital Self-Service Channels Enhanced for Automated Interactions
calculation_method: Count of new automated self-service features introduced in TRA digital channels (e.g., taxpayer portals, trader portals, mobile apps, or APIs) during the reporting period that have been developed, tested, deployed, and are operational in the production environment
means_of_verification: System release notes and deployment reports, ICT change management records, user acceptance testing and go-live reports, digital platform documentation, updated portal/mobile application feature lists, and ICT/Digital Transformation progress reports.
data_source: System release notes and deployment reports

kpi_name: Number of courses/modules conducted through e-learning platforms
definition: 2.1.3 ICT in teaching, learning and research enhanced
calculation_method: Number of e-learning courses delivered
means_of_verification: E-learning platform records (e.g., Moodle)

kpi_name: Number of staffs trained on e-learning training delivery
definition: 2.1.3 ICT in teaching, learning and research enhanced
calculation_method: Number of participants enrolled in e-learning courses
means_of_verification: E-learning training calendar, Learning Management System (LMS) and training reports

kpi_name: End-to-End automation Academic and Support Processes Automation Rate
definition: 2.1.3 ICT in teaching, learning and research enhanced
calculation_method: Number of processes executed entirely through digital systems divided by total number of processes times 100 (Automation Rate)
means_of_verification: System-based approvals and transactions reports

kpi_name: Upgraded network Bandwidth h/access to support Learning Management System (LMS)
definition: 2.1.3 ICT in teaching, learning and research enhanced
calculation_method: Bandwidth scores recorded in the platform
means_of_verification: 1. Network performance monitoring reports (speed, uptime, latency), 2. Bandwidth utilization reports

kpi_name: Percentage of Integrated Digital Payment Channels for Tax Compliance
definition: 2.2 Enhanced Enterprise Data Integration and Tax Eligibility Intelligence
calculation_method: (Number of priority digital payment platforms whose transaction data trails are integrated into TRA's enterprise data platform and analytics systems for tax compliance monitoring ÷ Total number of identified priority digital payment platforms) × 100.
means_of_verification: Enterprise data platform/data warehouse integration reports, API or data exchange configuration records, data sharing agreements with payment service providers, system integration and deployment reports, analytics dashboards, and ICT/Data Integration progress reports.
data_source: Enterprise data platform/data warehouse integration reports

kpi_name: Number of Internal and External systems Integrated
definition: 2.2 Enhanced Enterprise Data Integration and Tax Eligibility Intelligence
calculation_method: Count of distinct internal TRA systems and priority external data sources whose data streams have been successfully TRA integrated into the enterprise data platform, standardized, transformed into analytics-ready data models, and made available for analytics and compliance intelligence use.
means_of_verification: TRA Enterprise data platform integration logs, data integration architecture documentation, ETL/data pipeline configuration records, enterprise data catalogue or metadata repository, data sharing agreements with external institutions, and ICT/Data Integration progress reports.
data_source: TRA Enterprise data platform integration logs

kpi_name: Growth in Analytics-Driven Tax Eligibility
definition: 2.2 Enhanced Enterprise Data Integration and Tax Eligibility Intelligence
calculation_method: (Number of new tax eligibility cases or discrepancies identified through data analytics in the current year − Number identified in the previous year) ÷ Number identified in the previous year) × 100.
means_of_verification: TRA Enterprise analytics platform reports, compliance risk management system records, data matching and intelligence reports, case management system logs, annual compliance and risk management reports, and ICT/Data Analytics program performance reports.

kpi_name: Enterprise Data Integration Maturity
definition: 2.2 Enhanced Enterprise Data Integration and Tax Eligibility Intelligence
calculation_method: Average maturity score derived from an annual assessment of key enterprise data integration dimensions (e.g., data integration, data quality, accessibility, governance, metadata/ontologies, and analytics readiness) using an approved maturity framework rated on a scale of 1–5.
means_of_verification: Enterprise data integration maturity assessment reports, enterprise data architecture documentation, data governance policies, enterprise data catalogue/metadata repository records, data quality monitoring reports, analytics platform documentation, and internal or independent assessment reports.
data_source: Enterprise data integration maturity assessment reports

kpi_name: Average data freshness latency for critical
definition: 2.2.1 Unified Enterprise Data Platform Established
calculation_method: Average time (in hours) between the timestamp when data is created or updated in critical source systems and the timestamp when the data becomes available for analysis in the enterprise data platform, calculated across all monitored critical datasets during the reporting period.
means_of_verification: Enterprise data platform monitoring dashboards, ETL/data pipeline logs, data integration monitoring tools, enterprise data catalogue/metadata records, system integration documentation, and ICT/Data Engineering performance reports.

kpi_name: Number of unique AI/Machine Learning (ML) models deployed for tax eligibility
definition: 2.2.2 AI-driven Tax Eligibility Intelligence Models Deployed
calculation_method: Count of distinct AI or machine learning models designed for tax eligibility identification that have been developed, validated, deployed in the production environment, and are actively generating analytical outputs or alerts for compliance monitoring.
means_of_verification: AI/ML model registry or inventory, analytics platform deployment logs, model validation and testing reports, enterprise analytics dashboards, model technical documentation, compliance/case management system reports, and ICT/Data Analytics implementation progress reports.

kpi_name: Accuracy rate of AI/ML tax eligibility
definition: 2.2.2 AI-driven Tax Eligibility Intelligence Models Deployed
calculation_method: (Number of AI/ML-generated tax eligibility or compliance risk cases confirmed as valid through human review, compliance checks, or audit outcomes ÷ Total number of AI/ML-generated cases reviewed during the reporting period) × 100.
means_of_verification: AI/ML analytics platform reports, model performance evaluation reports, compliance risk management system records, audit or investigation reports, case management system logs, and data analytics/model monitoring reports.

kpi_name: Percentage of critical data elements with defined ownership and quality rules
definition: 2.2.3 Enterprise Data Governance Framework Operationalized
calculation_method: (Number of critical data elements in the enterprise data platform with formally assigned data owners and defined data quality rules ÷ Total number of identified critical data elements) × 100.
means_of_verification: Enterprise data catalogue/metadata repository, data governance framework documentation, data stewardship registers, data quality rules and monitoring reports, enterprise data governance committee records, and ICT/Data Governance implementation reports.

kpi_name: Average data quality score for critical datasets
definition: 2.2.3 Enterprise Data Governance Framework Operationalized
calculation_method: Average of composite data quality scores for all critical datasets in the enterprise data platform, where each dataset's score is calculated based on predefined data quality dimensions (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and validity) measured against established quality rules.
means_of_verification: Enterprise data quality monitoring dashboards, data quality assessment reports, enterprise data catalogue/metadata repository, data quality rule configuration records, data profiling/validation tool outputs, and ICT/Data Governance performance reports.

kpi_name: Percentage of data governance policy breaches/incidents reported and resolved
definition: 2.2.3 Enterprise Data Governance Framework Operationalized
calculation_method: (i) Count of data governance policy breaches or incidents formally reported during the reporting period; and (ii) Percentage of reported incidents resolved within the defined timeframe = (Number of incidents resolved within the defined timeframe ÷ Total number of reported incidents) × 100.
means_of_verification: Data governance incident management system logs, information security incident reports, enterprise data governance committee records, internal audit/compliance reports, ICT security monitoring logs, and incident resolution documentation.
data_source: Data governance incident management system logs

kpi_name: Value of AI-Detected Fraud and Non-Compliance Confirmed through Investigation and Digital Forensic Examination
definition: 2.3 Advanced Risk and Predictive Prevention Capability
calculation_method: Sum of monetary values (TZS) of fraud, tax evasion, and non-compliance cases initially identified by AI/ML systems and subsequently verified through audits, investigations, digital forensic examination or compliance review within the fiscal year.
means_of_verification: Data governance policy breaches or incidents formally reported during the reporting period
data_source: Data governance policy breaches or incidents

kpi_name: Percentage Reduction in number of cyber threats.
definition: 2.3 Advanced Risk and Predictive Prevention Capability
calculation_method: Percentage reduction in cyber fraud incidents detected by internal monitoring systems compared to the previous reporting period
means_of_verification: Cybersecurity monitoring system reports, ICT fraud detection system logs, IT security incident registers, SOC incident reports, and internal audit/risk management reports

kpi_name: Coverage of Tamper-Proof Digital Controls
definition: 2.3 Advanced Risk and Predictive Prevention Capability
calculation_method: ((Estimated value of undetected irregularities before predictive analytics implementation – Estimated value after implementation) ÷ Estimated value before implementation) × 100. (Number of high-risk revenue streams, tax categories, or taxpayer segments with deployed and operational tamper-proof digital controls ÷ Total number of identified high-risk areas) × 100.
means_of_verification: ICT/digital controls deployment logs, system integration reports, operational monitoring dashboards, audit/compliance verification reports, blockchain/smart contract ledger records, and ICT/Digital Transformation implementation reports.

kpi_name: Predictive Risk Detection Accuracy Rate
definition: 2.3 Advanced Risk and Predictive Prevention Capability
calculation_method: Number of predictive alerts that result in confirmed non-compliance divided by Total number of predictives identified times 100
means_of_verification: Data Source: 1. 1. Predictive Models Performance Report 2. Compliance Investigation / Audit / Examination Outcome Reports Frequency: Quarterly Assumptions: 1. Risk models are continuously updated and validated. 2. Adequate investigations are conducted on generated predictive alerts.

kpi_name: Percentage of System uptime
definition: 2.3.1 Integrated Advanced Analytics and AI Platform Deployed
